messages:
Leah: Quick idea: add ephemeral KMS grants for infra-only SAST runs to reduce noise. Will include pr_id in audit row. Thoughts? @Omar

Omar: Fine with it if audit contains pr_id, repo, issuer and ttl. Need RBAC so GH action principal only can request for repos with flag.

DevOps-Bot: Note: created RBAC ticket REQ-2026-900. Attach runbook link.

Jo: Can we auto-escalate to full-scan if changed files >20 or network/*.proto touched? Also prefer fail-closed for infra changes.

Leah: Agree on escalation and fail-closed for infra-sensitive. I'll write RFC and pilot on infra-config repo for 1 week.

Omar: I'll update keystore audit schema (add pr_id, repo_path) and add index. Will gate behind feature flag. Ping me for tests.
